summary: CPKC filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Canadian Pacific Railway Company, is issuing C$1.8 billion of notes in Canada across four tranches: C$500 million 4.20% due 2030, C$550 million 4.60% due 2033, C$300 million 4.90% due 2037 and C$450 million 5.40% due 2056, all guaranteed by the parent. Expected closing is October 6, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is an ordinary investment-grade shelf takedown, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch for pricing/spread and use of proceeds.
